description: Adjust a memory salience weight based on recall utility (consumes 1 Write API call; non-idempotent because repeated calls compound the salience delta) and return { updated }. Enforces organization ownership on id; useful=true boosts salience toward 1.0 while useful=false dampens noisy or outdated entries without deleting them. Use after recall_memories to tune future ranking quality; use forget_memory instead for permanent removal, or consolidate to merge duplicate records.

useful.description: True to boost salience when helpful; false to dampen salience when stale or noisy.

name: feedback

updated.description: True when the target memory existed and its salience was updated.

title: Record Memory Feedback
